note: Machine-readable known-red set for the full unit suite on this fork, used by local/gate-unit.mjs.
A failure listed here is reported but does not fail the gate; a failure outside it does. Same
shape as local/e2e-known-failure-titles.json, which already gates the scheduled e2e lane.
Every entry names a test title, not a file. A file-level entry (`"test": "*"`) also masks a NEW
failure inside that file, which is how `the screen prompt a pane is holding answers null for a
pane it cannot bind to a terminal` hid for two syncs: it asserts null where the implementation
documents undefined, so it was fixed rather than recorded.
An entry for a file the gate does not run is a problem, not a pass. The gate runs upstream's own
unit lane (`UNIT_EXCLUDE`), so the 80 files that list drops — the electron, node-pty, live-shell
and cross-version-wire ones — are upstream-quarantined and deliberately absent here.
Keeping entries: documented in LOCAL-PATCHES.md => keep even when a run does not reproduce it
(the machine state varies). Observed once and undocumented => prune it; `unseen` is the signal.
An entry that passes is reported stale; prune it. LOCAL-PATCHES.md stays the evidence, this file
stays the assertion, and both change in the same commit.

observedRun.subject: the fifteen files the previous manifest named, plus the two the 2026-10-21 sync left unlisted
observedRun.note: Reconciliation run for the tightening below, not a gate verdict: it runs the allowlisted files and the two formerly-unlisted ones, so it cannot see a red in any other file. Every record closes: allowlisted + upstreamQuarantined + fixed = failingRecords. The full-suite verdict for the revision that ships is recorded in LOCAL-PATCHES.md, because this file changing is what invalidates that verdict's cache key.

unhandledErrors.headline: Error: selector_not_found
unhandledErrors.evidence: Raised by src/main/runtime/orca-runtime.test.ts: `does not coalesce concurrent same-id removals on different hosts` hands the in-flight removal promise to the second caller without awaiting it, and that promise rejects with selector_not_found. Pre-existing at 1a64dbe2f6; the coalescing map is upstream code. Declared for the headline, not for a test: the 2026-10-22 full run raised none.

unhandledErrors.headline: Error: [vitest-pool]: Worker node-runtime emitted error.
unhandledErrors.evidence: LOCAL-PATCHES.md: a node-runtime worker exited with SIGTRAP during the full run while it was on src/main/plugins/plugin-service-reconciliation.test.ts; that file passes 11/11 alone in 2.4 s, so the crash is pool/memory pressure across a 19-minute run, not a failing test.
